decode_layout: 128 bytes total, four 32-byte raw leaf fields: leaf1=input[0..32], leaf2=input[32..64], leaf3=input[64..96], leaf4=input[96..128]. The original TrustedAdvice/UntrustedAdvice wrappers are host-side plumbing only; the lifted computation reads the raw leaf bytes. Input shorter than 128 bytes returns an empty Vec (total decode, no panic). Output = the 32 raw bytes of the [u8;32] Merkle root.
entry_called: jolt_inlines_sha2::Sha256::digest (lifted merkle_tree body: 4 leaf digests -> h01/h23 -> root digest)
